about.text: A sweet porridge of rolled millet made with sour milk and sugar, served in Senegal and Gambia; lakh sow is topped with cream and ngalakh with a baobab-fruit and peanut sauce. In Mauritania the name is given to curds or yoghurt with grated coconut over sweet millet porridge.

sources.text: The making and serving in Senegal and Gambia, and the Mauritanian dish, from these.
